No scale reference or measurement visible in either photo; size cannot be judged remotely

risks.risk: Actual screen size may be smaller than claimed 86 inches
risks.proof: A photo with a tape measure or a known-size reference object (door, person) beside the TV
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed size, assume smaller/mid-size worst case

risks.risk: Model number may not match seller's claim, affecting panel tech and true specs
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the model/serial sticker on the back panel
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified/generic LG model worst case

risks.risk: Physical damage to screen, frame, or back panel not visible from front-facing shots
risks.proof: Photos of the back panel, edges, and screen in powered-off state at angle to catch scratches/cracks
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic condition unknown, worst case moderate damage

risks.risk: Dead pixels or screen uniformity issues not visible under demo content
risks.proof: Video clip showing full-screen solid color (white/black/red) across entire panel

risks.risk: Remote control, power cable, and wall mount bracket may not be included
risks.proof: Photo of all accessories laid out together with the TV

risks.risk: Soundbar and small streaming box may not be part of the sale
risks.proof: Seller confirmation in writing plus a photo showing all items tagged together as one lot
risks.if_unproven: priced as TV only, soundbar/box excluded

risks.risk: Age and warranty status unknown, affecting remaining useful life
risks.proof: Photo of purchase receipt or warranty card with date

risks.risk: Port functionality (HDMI, USB) and internal smart features may be faulty
risks.proof: Video clip showing ports in use with a connected device and apps like Netflix launching successfully
risks.if_unproven: priced as functionality unverified, worst case partial failure

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the model/serial number sticker on the back of the TV
Photo with a tape measure or known-size object next to the screen to confirm 86-inch size
Full-screen solid-color test photo or video (white/black) to check for dead pixels or uniformity issues
Photos of the back panel and all edges showing no physical damage
Photo of all included accessories (remote, power cable, wall mount bracket) together with the TV
Clarification and photo proof on whether soundbar and streaming box are included in the sale
Photo of purchase receipt or warranty document if available
response.reason: The witness confirms this is an LG smart TV, so it can be priced, but the claimed 86-inch size, specific model, and 4K UHD spec are unverified from the photos, so pricing must assume the worst case until model/size/condition proof is provided.
